name: What is the typical timeline for designing and building a home addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for designing and building a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a home addition project typically involves several phases. The design phase, including architectural plans and permits, can take several months, often 3-6 months, depending on the project's scope and city review processes. Construction itself can then range from 4 months for a smaller addition to over a year for more extensive projects like a second story. We work to establish a realistic schedule upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design and permitting can take 3-6 months. Construction typically ranges from 4 months to over a year, depending on the addition's scope.
